summary: Tested the three new features: (1) 30-day soft-delete grace window + restore, (2) deletion receipt email via Emergent mailer, and (3) share OG endpoints for rich link unfurling. Backend: 12/12 pytest assertions pass covering DELETE /api/auth/me returning {pending_deletion, deletion_purge_at, grace_days:30}, staff/owner blocked with 403, session still usable after soft-delete, POST /api/auth/me/restore clearing pending state, GET /api/auth/restore/redirect?token= returning HTML 'Account restored' and clearing pending, and all share endpoints (home/clinic/blog/guide/refer) returning OG+Twitter meta with proper title/desc/image and ref-preservation on canonical og:url. Frontend: DeletionBanner renders correctly on Profile and More tab with correct localized text ('Account scheduled for deletion on Sep 26, 2026.' + 'Cancel' button), no raw i18n keys leaked, testID deletion-banner + deletion-banner-cancel present. Share buttons on Videos, Education, Clinic public (/c/dr-joshi-uro), and Guide (/guides/turp) tap without crashing. Test patient is left restored (non-pending) as instructed.

issues: Share icon button uses accessibilityLabel='Share clinic' but has no testID — makes automated testing harder. Reference: /app/frontend/app/c/[slug].tsx:243-258

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow"' repeatedly during renders. Not blocking but should be migrated.
Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — RN core deprecation.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID='clinic-share' to the share button in /app/frontend/app/c/[slug].tsx to enable direct e2e clicks.
(Optional, unrelated) Migrate deprecated RN style props (shadow* → boxShadow, textShadow* → textShadow, pointerEvents prop → style.pointerEvents) — noisy in console but non-blocking.
No action needed for the three tested features — all working as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: `_cancel_pending_deletion` correctly $unsets deletion_requested_at/deletion_purge_at and invalidates auth_cache. Good.
auth.py: DELETE /api/auth/me returns 200 (soft-delete) with grace_days=30 exactly as required. Restore token TTL bound to purge_at (30 days).

share.py: refer canonical URL is built as `/refer?ref=<code>` and if `ref` query param is passed, an extra `&ref=` gets appended — meaning refer/<code>?ref=<code> yields two ref params (`/refer?ref=CODE&ref=CODE`). Both refer-with-path-only and refer with ?ref query are used in tests and the second ref is idempotent, but ideally dedupe. Currently harmless because the value matches.
mailer.py: `_assert_safe_email` guardrails run before every send; deletion receipt template is server-side only. Good.

auth.py L317: expression `expires_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if expires_at.tzinfo is None else expires_at < datetime.now(...)` has ambiguous operator precedence — works today because the ternary returns a datetime that Python then compares, but this is a legibility landmine (not in scope of this review).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (functional smoke — share buttons don't crash; banner renders with correct copy)
